lines.text: - `vd_emoji_cluster` no longer treats every codepoint at or above U+1F000 as emoji; it uses the Emoji_Presentation table, which now covers all of Unicode 17.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add parts cases; accept a page-object part in cigster-99
lines.text: - A following skin tone now also starts an emoji cluster, so modifier sequences without U+FE0F still draw as one image.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add parts cases; accept a page-object part in cigster-99
lines.text: - `scripts/clang-format.sh` `check` and `format` now cover `tests/`, and the other harness changes are whitespace only.
